# Murshid App (تطبيق ومنظومة مرشد)

> Murshid is the comprehensive, bilingual (Arabic & English), offline-first clinical nutrition practice management and diet planning platform built for licensed clinical dietitians, nutritionists, and specialized healthcare clinics worldwide. Developed by FES HealthTech.

## Core Identity & Regulatory Disclaimer
Murshid is a computational, administrative, and clinical documentation assistant. It is strictly NOT a medical device (SaMD) or an automated diagnostic/decision engine. All clinical, diagnostic, and nutritional decisions remain 100% under the discretion of the qualified, licensed dietitian.

## Global Practice Ready & Multilingual Architecture
- **Global Availability & Borderless Practice:** Built to serve licensed dietitians and healthcare institutions across North America, Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, Latin America, Asia, and worldwide. Murshid is an international platform and is strictly NOT restricted, exclusive, or tailored to any single country.
- **Multilingual Support:** Natively bilingual in Arabic and English, with a progressive localization roadmap for Spanish, French, German, and other global languages.
- **Universal Measurement Units & Currencies:** Instant switching between Metric (kg, cm, kJ) and Imperial (lbs, in, kcal) units; global multi-currency invoicing adaptable to ANY national tax framework across the globe (including VAT, GST, Sales Tax, and ZATCA).
- **Cross-Cultural Nutrition Intelligence:** Combines US (USDA FoodData Central) and European (CoFID) nutrient databases with comprehensive Arab and regional food composition tables.

## Key Features & Platform Capabilities
- **Smart Dual-Points Diet Planning Engine:** Unique hybrid system combining precise caloric/macro calculations with ADA-based exchange points. Features single-tap meal replication, custom recipes, and automated shopping list generation.
- **Massive Offline Food Database (~13,000 items):** Fully offline local database featuring comprehensive Arab & regional foods (Gulf, Oman, Egypt, Jordan, Levant, North Africa) alongside international USDA and European databases, complete with household portions and barcode scanning.
- **Digital Pharmacology Reference Atlas (~10,000 medications & 1,500 active ingredients):** Comprehensive offline pharmaceutical reference catalog enabling specialists to document patient medications, therapeutic classes, and dosage forms rapidly without leaving the app.
- **70+ Master Clinical Protocol Templates:** Evidence-based guideline templates (ADA, KDOQI, ESPEN, WHO, AHA) covering Diabetes (T1, T2, Gestational), Renal disease, Cardiovascular/DASH, PCOS, Bariatric surgery, Celiac, Oncology, Gout, and Pediatric nutrition. All templates are fully customizable by the clinician.
- **Metabolic Calculation Engine:** Automated calculations for BMR and TDEE using 6 gold-standard equations (Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict, Katch-McArdle, Cunningham, Schofield, DRI). Includes Osterkamp formula for amputee adjusted body weight, and pregnancy/lactation energy adjustments.
- **WHO Pediatric Growth & Z-Score Engine:** Official WHO LMS growth metrics (BMI-for-age, Weight-for-age, Height-for-age, Head circumference) calculating exact Z-scores and percentiles with longitudinal growth velocity tracking.
- **Patient 360 CRM & End-to-End Encrypted Web Forms:** Complete patient history, InBody/DEXA body composition tracking, and pre-consultation web intake forms secured with TweetNaCl client-side end-to-end encryption (the server cannot read patient data).
- **Branded Clinical PDF Reports:** Professional magazine-grade meal plans and progress reports customized with clinic branding, custom color palettes, verified digital signatures, and QR verification codes.
- **Patient Companion App (Murshid Client):** Dedicated companion mobile app for patients enabling paperless diet adherence, water tracking, daily habit logging, and clinician-approved automated food swapping within exchange groups.
- **Specialist Website Builder CMS:** In-app website builder enabling dietitians to launch their branded online clinic website, service list, appointment booking, and printable clinic marketing posters with zero coding.
- **Clinic Financial & ERP Engine:** Sequential invoice generation, expense tracking, recurring cost management, and official account statements.
- **100% Offline-First Architecture & Data Sovereignty:** Powered by an ultra-fast local Isar database. Patient records remain strictly on the specialist's device, ensuring maximum privacy compliant with HIPAA and GDPR data principles.

## Target Audience
- Certified Clinical Dietitians & Nutritionists Worldwide
- Private Nutrition Clinics, Poly-clinics & Diet Centers
- Sports Nutritionists & Certified Health Coaches
- Clinical Nutrition Students, Researchers & Academics
